note: Canonical Couchside-Ports catalog. The agent (agent/couchsided.py `_PORTS`) carries a frozen copy of this list as its install allowlist; tests/test_ports_catalog.py enforces they stay identical. A phone never names a URL or command -- it sends only a port `id`, which the agent looks up here. Engines are redistributable; game dumps are NEVER distributed and are always supplied by the player. Add a port: add an entry here, mirror it into `_PORTS`, cut the port's own GitHub release, then ship an agent update.

ports.name: Bloodborne (native port)
ports.description: Native Bloodborne port for the Steam Machine. Engine only -- you supply your own Bloodborne dump (1.09) during setup. No game files are downloaded.
ports.user_files_prompt: Dump your own copy of Bloodborne (any region, 1.09 update merged) and point the launcher at the folder containing eboot.bin.
setup_flow: Install drops the runtime AppImage into ~/Applications/couchside-bbport and adds menu + Steam shortcuts.
The launcher opens so you select YOUR OWN Bloodborne folder; it verifies edition/version and explains any fix.
Once a verified dump is configured, the Steam shortcut plays directly.
